title: Birational description of Fano schemes on two quadrics by symmetric powers of hyperbolic reductions
author: Lena Ji; Fumiaki Suzuki
work: Arithmetic and birational properties of linear spaces on intersections of two quadrics
source_version: Journal de l Ecole polytechnique-Mathematiques 12 (2025), 1161-1196; DOI 10.5802/jep.308; published 2025-08-18
difficulty_reason: With standard hyperbolic reduction and Reid’s quadratic-pencil results supplied, the authors still construct an explicit incidence isomorphism from their blow-up model and descend a general-position morphism from the Fano scheme to the symmetric power over an arbitrary nonclosed field. Their complete proof combines local quadratic-form normal forms, geometric connectedness and a smooth-locus open immersion to identify the birational class, while preserving the zero-dimensional alternative by the original length comparison. This source-local birational construction is beyond ordinary PhD qualification problems.
